1_approved_contact.description: Standard valid contact who has given consent and is not on the DND registry. Should be APPROVED and persisted in Cloud SQL.

2_blocked_dnd_by_flag.description: Valid contact payload but dnd_status is explicitly true. Must be BLOCKED and recorded in audit log only.

3_blocked_dnd_by_suppression_registry.description: Payload has dnd_status=false, but the phone number matches the national/internal DND suppression list (+919999999999). DND service must catch and BLOCK it.

4_invalid_contact_missing_fields.description: Fails validation because mandatory fields 'source' and 'owner' are missing. Should fail fast in the Validator step.

5_pubsub_wrapped_sample.description: Format when received from Pub/Sub push subscription or Eventarc trigger (base64 encoded message data).
